data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/prompts/strata/posture-writer.md (silent, runs after posture-dialog approval). Atomic write via mktemp + mv -f. Writes approved `## Strata Posture` section to project-understanding.md. Idempotent (replaces existing section if present; otherwise appends).
**Why**: Posture section is the final write; atomicity prevents half-written file under crash.
**Scope**:
- IN: Atomic mktemp + mv -f write; section replace-or-append logic; idempotent re-run.
- OUT: Posture content (S6 owns approval); pre-Posture-section content management.

## Done Definitions
- When complete, write is atomic via mktemp + mv -f ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, idempotent re-run produces zero diff (replaces existing section) ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, an interrupted write does not leave a partial Posture section ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for replace, append, and crash-recovery paths

## Considerations
- [Reliability] mv -f is atomic on same filesystem; document if cross-fs

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an onboarding consumer, posture-writer.md atomically writes the approved Posture section
